scope: Pure text transform, source identities, mutable buffer edge transport, instruction ordering, scalar return handling, literal-safe exact SSA bijection. No HIA parser/verifier/compiler/runtime execution.

provenance.actual_original_production_history: Supplied root custody is retained; this review independently verifies Git source identities but does not repeat the original ZIP member readback.

findings.finding: The sole ignored write_scalar call is the penultimate instruction of the original decode branch and is followed by the six-argument loop jump. Its two mutable inputs are exactly that continuation's mutable operands. Four additional carry values are readbuf,u64,u64,bool; neither mutable buffer is copied into the carry set. Every cloned writer edge forwards the same ordered two mutable block parameters. Return replaces the writer return with the original continuation using the current pair plus the unchanged carry values.
findings.limits: This is exact-source CFG/type inspection, not a substitute for Core linearity validation.

findings.finding: All seven new decode functions contain fourteen blocks and eighteen control-flow edges. Every edge has exactly the destination arity and matching value types, and none repeats a mutable edge operand. All newly introduced SSA definitions are unique. All original functions outside the declared decode targets and role27 f2 are byte-identical.

Writer block instructions are copied in the same per-block order; branch conditions and successor ordering remain those of the original writer. Each of the eight static get/put calls expands the actual helper's straight-line body in its call position. Individual loads/stores, wrapping additions, integer casts, and checked shifts remain individual operations in their original order. No cursor is cached across scalar iterations and no byte-wise operation is combined into a wide memory access.
findings.limits: Preserves the local sequence of possible partial writes/traps by source construction; actual trap/output equivalence remains a required native test.

findings.finding: The writer result has exactly one textual occurrence (its original definition), so removing the unused call result creates no dangling use. A get helper whose return is a locally defined u64 maps that definition to the original call result. A put helper that returns an input parameter is admitted only when the original call result has no use. Its entire body is retained, and no invented return value is substituted. These precise actual helpers have the expected scalar types.

Role27 f2 contains 1,281 distinct SSA spellings, with old maximum suffix 2,840. The supplied complete bijection maps them to v0..v1280. The independent forward transformation equals the candidate f2 and the reverse equals the complete original f2. Quoted literals contain no SSA-looking v-token, so string values are unchanged. Numeric constants, function names, block labels, operation/attribute structure, and all other function bytes remain unchanged.
findings.limits: A general text regex alpha-renamer would require its literal checks; this conclusion concerns the pinned exact source and checked bijection only.

findings.finding: The transform's normalizeFunction deliberately erases callee numbers while checking function shape. The separate exact-module review therefore also binds each actual get/put/write_scalar/decode mapping from the proof, replays against those actual module functions, and compares the complete submitted candidate. No generic callee-equivalence claim is made from normalized shape alone.

The resulting textual profiles stay inside the original function/block/op/block-parameter/SSA bounds, including role27 78 functions /1,441 blocks /6,878 operations /15 parameters /maximum suffix2,000. There is no 128-operations-per-block limit. These counts are textual diagnostics only and do not certify canonical HIA syntax, Core validity, successful B3 output, full 63-image linkage, observable public behavior, or speed.
